scripts.build: npm run build -w @tsr/api && npm run build -w @tsr/web && npm run build -w @tsr/worker
scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:reset: npm run dev:reset:prepare && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,web,worker -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:worker"
scripts.dev:prepare: npm run dev:infra && npm run dev:cleanup && npm run dev:ports && npm run prisma:generate && npm run db:push
scripts.dev:reset:prepare: npm run dev:prepare && npm run clean:web
scripts.dev:api: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env PORT=3001 npm run start:dev -w @tsr/api
scripts.dev:web: dotenv -e .env -- cross-env PORT=3000 NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3001/api NEXT_PUBLIC_WS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3001 npm run dev -w @tsr/web
scripts.db:push: dotenv -e .env -- npm exec -w @tsr/api -- prisma db push --skip-generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:generate: dotenv -e .env -- npm exec -w @tsr/api -- prisma generate --schema prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.verify:precommit: npm exec -w @tsr/api -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false && npm run build -w @tsr/web && npm exec -w @tsr/worker -- tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit --incremental false && docker compose config --quiet
